text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VI · Suits Relating to Movable Property
 Section: 71::Three years.
]


To recover movable property deposited or pawned, and afterwards bought from the depository or pawnee for a valuable consideration.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the sale becomes known to the plaintiff.
